summary: R13 QA PASS. Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases in test_final_qa_r13.py cover (a) GET /admin/drivers-missing-phone shape parity, (b) POST /nudge auth guards (401 anon / 403 customer / 403 driver), (c) happy path first call → {ok:true, flagged:331, sent:0, skipped:331, failed:0} in preview (RESEND_API_KEY blank → all rows land as provider_offline, per spec), (d) second POST within 24h → same 331 flagged, sent:0, skipped:331 all via dedupe_24h, (e) users.nudged_add_phone_at ISO string + nudged_add_phone_last_status + nudged_add_phone_by_id fields stamped after nudge, (f) render_driver_add_phone_nudge subject exact, html/text each contain 'phone' ≥ 2× and 'driver/profile' ≥ 1×, driver name mentioned in text fallback. R12 regression 24/24 still PASS. Frontend Playwright: admin@cargoone.com → /admin/users banner renders with 'Email all 331 drivers' button; window.confirm Cancel fires 0 POST requests (verified via network listener); Accept triggers POST and result pill data-testid='admin-nudge-result' shows 'Emailed 0 · queued 331 · failed 0'. Driver testdriver@example.com → /driver/notifications header toggle data-testid='driver-notif-chime-toggle' defaults aria-pressed='true' with localStorage 'cargoone_notification_chime_enabled'='1'; click flips to false/'0'; click again restores to true/'1'. Driver dashboard bell badge data-testid='driver-notifications-badge' shows live unread count (6).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /admin/drivers-missing-phone/nudge cleanly separates 'sent' vs 'skipped(provider_offline)' vs 'failed' and only stamps nudged_add_phone_at for sent/skipped-by-provider so a hard failure can retry — nice UX detail.
24h dedupe uses ISO string in users doc with tz-aware fallback for legacy naive datetimes — good defensive parse.

services/email.py render_driver_add_phone_nudge subject exact-match with spec; HTML CTA links to APP_ORIGIN/driver/profile; text fallback mentions driver name + profile URL. Both html+text contain 'phone' ≥ 2× as required.

useNotificationChime hook mirrors useMessageChime cleanly: same 2-note bing envelope (880Hz + 1320Hz sine), 15s poll, primedRef gate so first poll never chimes, unlock-on-gesture listeners. Storage key correctly namespaced ('cargoone_notification_chime_enabled') so it doesn't collide with useMessageChime's key.
Notifications.jsx re-fetches list on chime.unread change — proper live-update wiring per spec.
Admin Users.jsx nudge button correctly wraps window.confirm + async runNudge + disabled/label swap during flight + result pill — cancel path verified to fire zero network requests.
Pre-existing (R12): Users.jsx still has nested <button> in admin-user row triggering React hydration warning. Not R13-introduced; already flagged in R12 report.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 flows: admin nudge banner + driver notif chime toggle)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is (admin@cargoone.com, testdriver@example.com, testcustomer@example.com). No mutations required.
seed_data_creation: None — the 331 legacy phoneless drivers already exist in preview and were used for both the count assertion and dedupe verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R13 lives in /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r13.py (7 tests, ~3s runtime). Key preview behaviour: RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally blank so every nudge lands as skipped(provider_offline) — DO NOT treat sent:0 as a defect. First nudge stamps users.nudged_add_phone_at; second call within 24h returns identical flagged/skipped counts with 'dedupe_24h' in skipped_reasons. Frontend: admin /admin/users banner has data-testid='admin-nudge-missing-phone' + data-testid='admin-nudge-result' with copy 'Emailed X · queued Y · failed Z'. Driver /driver/notifications has data-testid='driver-notif-chime-toggle' with aria-pressed reflecting localStorage 'cargoone_notification_chime_enabled' ('1'/'0', default '1'). useNotificationChime and useMessageChime coexist without fighting — different storage keys and different endpoints (/notifications vs /messages/unread-count).
rca of the issue: No new bugs. Both R13 P0/P1 deliverables (ops nudge endpoint + notification chime) land per spec.
